select t1.id, t1.name, t1.expression_category_id, t1.result, t1.expression, t1.expression_parse as expressionParse, t1.confirm_status, t2.ancestor_name as expressionCategoryName from bp_sys_expression t1 left join bp_sys_expression_category t2 on t1.expression_category_id = t2.id where t1.is_deleted = 0
and t1.name like concat('%',#{name},'%')
and t1.expression_category_id in
#{item}
order by t1.create_time desc

select t1.id, t1.name, t1.expression_category_id, t1.result, t1.expression, t1.expression_parse as expressionParse, t1.confirm_status from bp_sys_expression t1 where is_deleted = 0 and t1.confirm_status = 1 order by t1.create_time desc
SELECT id, expression_category_id AS parentId, name, result, expression, expression_parse, create_time FROM bp_sys_expression WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND confirm_status = 1 ORDER BY create_time DESC
